input_ownership: The new owning model, complete basis, I16 neutral stationary reference and their hashes are shared INPUT, not an independently ground-solved consumer result. All spectra and trajectories below must be newly computed in that H/reference.

primitive_units.flux: E is dimensionless canonical electric flux, eigenvalues -1,0,+1. Electric energy E^2/(2I), I16.
primitive_units.current: T=-t c_b^dag U c_a; J=-i(T-Tdag); dot E=i[H,E]=J. J has flux/time units.
primitive_units.physical_electric_field: F=E/I, dot F=J/I, electric power={E,J}/(2I). Do not equate physical field with canonical flux when changing I.
primitive_units.density: rho=n-1, dot rho=-B J. I-aware power and Gauss currents must use the SAME primitive J.

joint_response.sources: Small local circulation-electric, ImW and charge-dipole block, with associated primitive circulation current. Actual source rank and overlap will be reported; this is not a pole catalogue or a polarization count.
joint_response.signed_retarded: chi_ab(z)=sum_n [<Omega|A_a|n><n|A_b|Omega>/(z-omega_n)-<Omega|A_b|n><n|A_a|Omega>/(z+omega_n)]. Keep both signed denominators and complex off-diagonal residues.
joint_response.contact: For H(a)=exp(i a E_c) H exp(-i a E_c), H'(0)=-J_c and H''(0)=-sum_e c_e^2 (T_e+T_e^dag). Thus response d<J>/da=-<H''>-chi_JJ under H'=-aJ. Fully relaxed static curvature <H''>+chi_JJ(0) vanishes for exact field-basis unitary equivalence; it does not erase induced dynamics.
joint_response.feedback: A direct full joint-H Lehmann response is already matter/field reducible. It is NOT an irreducible polarization to reinsert in a Dyson equation. No external Maxwell propagator is introduced.
joint_response.continuity: For each mode, <n|J_c|Omega>=i omega_n <n|E_c|Omega>, and i omega_n <n|rho_v|Omega>=-sum_e B_ve <n|J_e|Omega>.

geometry_and_preparation.geometry: Same eight-site cube. Left yz loop is a truly local field operator. Opposite right yz face is disjoint; x bridges are the entire left/right hopping cut. Boundary link anchored left belongs to left ownership.
geometry_and_preparation.unitary: Use an actual left-loop Hermitian field generator and exponentiate on Omega; do not call O|Omega> causal preparation. Initial right owned energy/field/current correlations must match before evolution. If bare kick splits, this is not an absence-of-propagation argument; source eigenmode overlap and direction limitations remain explicit.
geometry_and_preparation.defeat: Evolve SAME Omega/pulse state pair with Hcut and Hoff and their OWN receiver energies, or exact all-basis commutator proof. Never reground either control or use full-H energy under a cut law.
geometry_and_preparation.pair_content: Compare normalized selected-mode DIAGONAL D and charge variance to Omega. Vanishing C-even D transition to C- is only a selection rule and cannot exclude pair admixture.

interpretation_caps: Finite source-selected rays may be gapped, degenerate or mixed. No two chosen probes/five graph cycles => two photon polarizations; no expectation ReW<0 => Clifford identity; no band pseudospin => Noether spin; no one-cube low-q speed/Coulomb/continuum/Nature claim.
